redWitnesses.name: the gate was a one-sided FLOOR — 'louder' passes forever (the structural root)
redWitnesses.headState: blob-render.spec.ts asserted domeLumaStd (DOME_LUMA_STD_MIN=9) and centroidShift (CENTROID_SHIFT_MIN=0.012) as bare toBeGreaterThanOrEqual floors with NO ceiling — a garish dome and a lunging lean passed 'better'.
redWitnesses.disposition: FIXED — converted both to BANDS (paired toBeLessThanOrEqual ceilings) + added the no-blown-white worst-painted-luma witness. proof:blob-live-truth arm A source-parses the band structure (born-RED at HEAD: floor-only).

redWitnesses.name: the lighting cohort is over-bright — the skeuomorphic wet-plastic bead (D4)
redWitnesses.headState: specStrength:0.9 × energyNorm(shininess 32)=4.25 → a 3.83× over-unity glint crushed to a HARD WHITE spot over the dome; 5 lighting layers co-added on a ~0.14uv bead. The live BEFORE screenshot shows the blown-white specular hotspot.
redWitnesses.disposition: FIXED — re-derived specStrength against energyNorm (0.9 → 0.16, a sub-unity warm gleam), softened specShininess (32 → 20, a broad lobe), pulled iridescence (0.18 → 0.09) / sssScale (0.2 → 0.1) / coreGlow (0.1 → 0.06) / rimStrength (0.5 → 0.32) DOWN (one perceptual cue: rim + a whisper, not five layers), and CLAMPed the linear highlight before the OETF (min(highlight, vec3(0.85))). lit:true STAYS.

redWitnesses.name: the interaction is far too dramatic — the lunging hover (D5)
redWitnesses.headState: pointerStrength:0.45 (W15-REDRESS bumped 0.11→0.45 to clear the 0.012 floor by ≈9×, a MODELED 0.111 shift) + falloff smoothstep(0.65,…) + the curious-hover arousal-compound; the squash sa=1+speed·stretch reached ~2.25× on a flick (a taffy-pull).
redWitnesses.disposition: FIXED — pointerStrength 0.45 → 0.18 (a calm lean), falloff narrowed 0.65 → 0.5 (coherent but calm), the curious-hover arousal multiplier flattened (0.4+0.6·arousal → 0.7+0.15·arousal, decouples the mood-compound), and the squash velocity SATURATED (sa = 1 + tanh(speed·1.6)·stretch, capped at ~1.5× — no taffy-pull). NO new interaction code.

redWitnesses.name: blob-mood totally broken — the auto-mood clobbers manual setMood every frame (D7)
redWitnesses.headState: useMetaballRenderer calls mood.update(...) UNCONDITIONALLY every non-reduced frame; update falls through to setMood('idle') with no pointer/click/short-idle. So ~16ms after a manual blobRef.setMood(m), the auto-arc force-retargets to idle — every mood renders IDENTICAL (the pill highlights but the render never changes; the shipped setMood expose is a documented lie).
redWitnesses.disposition: FIXED — setMood(mood, { source }) carries a source discriminant; a manual setMood arms a manualOverride latch (the generalization of excitedHoldMs); update EARLY-RETURNS while the latch holds and RELEASES it on a fresh clicked OR rising-edge pointerActive over the live canvas; the latch is folded into isSettled (a pinned non-idle mood keeps the loop alive) + nextAutoMoodMs (no auto-arc to wake for). proof:blob-live-truth arm B source-parses the latch structure; arm C blob-mood-live.spec.ts proves the mood-DELTA persistence.

liveSetBands.note: RATIFY 1 — the band CEILINGS were set LIVE against the calm-bead render on the real device (darwin/Metal ANGLE), NOT pre-committed. The audit's modeled numbers MISPREDICTED the live truth (the cardinal lesson restated): the audit modeled domeLumaStd ≈16-18 (live: ≈65, dominated by the dark var(--primary) body falling to the cream rim, NOT the specular) and the HEAD lean centroidShift ≈0.11 (live: ≈0.04 — the over-dramatic lurch the audit modeled was an overestimate; the live lean was always calmer). The bands are the live-set restraint guards.

domeLumaStd.basis: painted-interior luma std-dev; floor catches a flat fill, ceiling catches a runaway over-bright dome

centroidShift.basis: centroid shift under a rightward hover-flick, fraction of width; floor catches an invisible lean, ceiling catches a lunge toward the modeled 0.11

highlightLumaMax.basis: worst-case painted-interior luma; the shader highlight clamp guarantees sub-unity, so a dome crushed to pure white (255) reds

before.read: a blown-white specular hotspot over the dark body — the skeuomorphic wet-plastic bead (D4 root); the lighter grid blobs ran worst painted luma 242-246.
before.moodDeltaRatio_excitedVsSleepy: ≈1.7 under the simulated HEAD clobber (both moods render the auto-arc idle — the documented lie)

after.read: a calm contained warm-cream bead with a soft dome/rim and NO blown hotspot; the dark-mode min-contrast rim guard keeps the luminous bead legible.
after.moodDeltaRatio_excitedVsSleepy: ≈19-21 (excited orbits ~20× the motion rate of sleepy — the manual setMood is AUTHORITATIVE)
after.moodPersistence: the pinned excited HELD across a 1.5s idle window at ≈5-7× the sleepy rate (NOT clobbered to idle); a fresh pointer-over RELEASES the latch back to the auto-arc

pairedPi.delta: BEFORE blown-white skeuomorphic bead + a clobbered (identical-every-mood) render → AFTER a calm warm-cream membrane + a 20× mood-delta that persists. The visual BEFORE/AFTER (the blown spot → the soft dome) is the binding close criterion.

ratifyDecisions.3_latchRelease: TAKEN-DEFAULT (either a fresh clicked OR a RISING-EDGE pointerActive over the live canvas releases the latch; a held hover releases ONCE then the auto-arc drives — an idle frame can never release).
ratifyDecisions.4_autoMoodProp: TAKEN-DEFAULT (ship the latch as the library-correct default; autoMood prop NOT added — the latch-release is NOT fiddly in the live audit, the mood pills drive a clean 20× delta + persistence, so the escape hatch is not warranted, no-overfitting).
